## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
Link the execution plan for cross-boundary work or consequential design choices.

## Validation

List the checks run and any remaining limitations.
For UI changes, include sanitized browser evidence of the affected journey.
For HTTP/database/lifecycle changes, report the isolated smoke result.

## Compatibility

Mention configuration, API, data migration, or documentation changes when relevant.
Update the affected knowledge pages, quality assessment and debt entries.
